/**
 * Map binder. You can gradually put service of the same type and retrieve them all as map.
 *
 * @param keyType
 * 		Key Type.
 * @param valueType
 * 		Service Type.
 * @return A new map binder.
 * @param <K>
 * 		Key type.
 * @param <V>
 * 		Service type.
 */
default <K, V> MapBinder<K, V> mapOf(@NonNull
Class<K> keyType, @NonNull
Reified<V> valueType) {
    // PATH: Test should invoke the next ServiceRegistry.multiBinder(...) [step in execution path]
    return multiBinder(Reified.map(keyType, valueType.getType()), new MapBinder<>());
}

/** * List all the properties under the given key. Example: * * 
 * user.name = "name"
 * user.password = "pass"
 *
* * A call to getProperties("user") give you a map like: * {user.name: name, user.password: pass} * * @param key * Key. * @return Properties under that key or empty map. */ @NonNull public Map getProperties(@NonNull String key) { // PATH: Test should invoke the next Environment.getProperties(...) [step in execution path] return getProperties(key, key); }
